newsitem.title: USA: Clifton Mining ups Yellow Cougar values.
newsitem.headline: Clifton Mining ups Yellow Cougar values.

text.p: Clifton Mining Co said the value of mineral resources within the company's Yellow Cougar shear vein has been upgraded by 41 percent following a recent assay program that indicated significant increases in proven and probable resources and average ore grade.

The company said the vein's proven and probable resources increased by about 7,750 tons compared to the more than 88,000 tons. Estimated levels of silver increased 26 percent to 1,320,305 ounces, while lead levels more than doubled, increasing to 11,155,370 pounds from 4,381,984 pounds. Gold estimates decreased to 4,371 ounces from 6,355 ounces.
The Yellow Cougar is one of 38 identified shear veins on Clifton's 5,100-acre property, located on the Utah/Nevada border. Eight have been sampled with precious metal resources calculated.
With only ten percent of the first 8 veins estimated, Clifton Mining's total proven and probable resources are calculated at more than 331,000 tons, the company isaid.
